title: tenant-sink-helm-terraform-idempotency-and-rollback-safety
author: Anya Patel
release_notes: Tenant-scoped audit sink lifecycle: Helm pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks plus idempotent Terraform module for sink provisioning. Adds installer wiring and migration guidance. No public API changes.
content:
Description: This PR implements tenant-scoped audit sink lifecycle controls for Private deployments. It addresses two reliability problems observed during on-prem upgrades: leftover external sink bindings after Helm rollbacks, and duplicate external resources created by repeated Terraform applies. Motivation: Regulated customers need deterministic retention, jurisdictional routing, and auditable lifecycle events for tenant audit sinks.

Scope: 1) Terraform module changes: refactor terraform/modules/audit_sink to make provisioning idempotent by creating a canonical sink_id resource and a sink_version token; use lifecycle ignore_changes for non-authoritative metadata and expose an explicit rotation path documented in module README. 2) Helm chart changes: add a pre-upgrade job (audit-reconcile.preupgrade) that validates desired bindings and creates placeholder CRs, and a post-rollback job (audit-cleanup.postrollback) that attempts best-effort cleanup and emits events if reconciliation fails. 3) Installer controller changes: installer now waits for the pre-upgrade hook to complete in tenant installer mode and emits structured installer audit events (tenant_id, sink_id, action, timestamp, operator_version). 4) CI and tests: integration workflow added to run terraform dry-run plus helm upgrade/rollback in the perf-canary harness, plus a small e2e to simulate slow pre-upgrade hooks.

Behavioral details: - Terraform: sink_id is the canonical resource; terraform will not create duplicate external sinks unless sink_version is explicitly incremented. Module README documents rotation and emergency rotation job. Examples for S3, GCS, and syslog proxies included. - Helm: pre-upgrade job runs with a scoped service account; chart templates create necessary RBAC only in tenant installer mode. The job has a 300s timeout and retries in the reconciler container. Post-rollback job runs unconditionally to attempt cleanup of placeholders. - Installer: waitForPreUpgradeHook API blocks chart upgrade completion until pre-upgrade reconciler signals success or timeout; installer logs structured JSON events for auditors.

Testing and CI: - Unit tests for terraform module logic and helm template rendering added. - Integration job ci/integration/helm-tf-upgrade.yml executes terraform plan/apply (dry-run mode) followed by helm upgrade and rollback and asserts no duplicate external resources and preserved bindings. - perf-canary e2e simulates slow hook pods to ensure timeout and retry behavior are sane. CI: build: pass, lint: pass, unit-tests: pass, integration-upgrade-path: pass, e2e-perf-canary: pass.

Files changed (representative): terraform/modules/audit_sink/main.tf, terraform/modules/audit_sink/outputs.tf, terraform/modules/audit_sink/README.md, charts/audit-log-exporter/templates/hooks/preupgrade-job.yaml, charts/audit-log-exporter/templates/hooks/postrollback-job.yaml, installer/controllers/auditbinding_controller.go, installer/docs/README-audit-sinks.md, ci/integration/helm-tf-upgrade.yml, tests/integration/test_terraform_idempotency.sh

Commands/operators notes: Operators upgrading older charts must run the provided init-reconcile one-liner to lift legacy sink CRs into the new canonical sink_id resource. Helm upgrade will fail fast if init-reconcile has not been performed to avoid accidental duplicates. Migration steps are documented in installer/docs/README-audit-sinks.md.

Review summary: - Reviewer Liam Chen requested comments explaining lifecycle ignore_changes; author added comments and a sink_version token approach. - Reviewer Sofia Martinez requested longer preupgrade timeouts; timeout set to 300s and retry logic added. - Reviewer Rajiv Kapoor asked about RBAC implications; charts now create a scoped serviceaccount and conditional clusterrolebinding only in tenant installer mode; tests added. - QA confirmed staging run showed no dangling S3 buckets and preserved sink bindings after upgrade+rollback.

Risks and mitigations: - Double-provisioning of external sinks: mitigated by sink_id canonical resource and sink_version gating. - Partial rollback leaving external resource: mitigated by post-rollback cleanup job and installer audit events that trigger the on-call runbook if cleanup fails. - Credential rotation: documented rotation procedure and emergency rotation job available.

Merge: squash and merge. Version bumps: terraform module minor version bump and chart minor bump included in merge commit.

Follow-ups: ENG-1428 implement automated migration tool for legacy CRs; SRE-71 add alerting for long-running preupgrade hooks.

Auditor notes: Installer emits structured events for each lifecycle action with tenant_id, sink_id, action, timestamp, and operator_version to provide an auditable trail for upgrades and rollbacks.
